title: What's for Dinner?

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW What's for Dinner?.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Kiana]] |location= Lurelin Village |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Purple Rupee * Seafood Paella }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|What's for Dinner?||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|What's for Dinner?}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Lurelin Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== In [[Lurelin Village]], [[Link]] can meet [[Kiana]], who explains that she is from a family of fishermen.{{Cite|This is Lurelin Village. We're a small fishing town and proud of it! My husband is a fisherman, and I have two sons who will probably grow up to be fishermen too.|Kiana|BotW}} She asks her son, [[Kinov]], what she should make for dinner.{{Cite|What should I cook for dinner?|Kiana|BotW}} He suggests Kiana Cook her [[Seafood Paella]],{{Cite|Make your {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}! It's so good and yummy and great!|Kinov|BotW}} which she agrees with.{{Cite|That settles it!
I'll make some {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}.|Kiana|BotW}} Though Kinov is happy about this,{{Cite|Yaaaaay!|Kinov|BotW}} Kiana admits to Link that she is missing the [[Goat Butter]] and [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]] to make the meal.{{Cite|We seem to be a bit short on ingredients though. We'll need {{Color BotW|Red|goat butter}} and a {{Color BotW|Red|hearty blueshell snail}}.|Kiana|BotW}} Due to how busy she is with housework, she has not had the time to go shopping for them.{{Cite|I'm so busy with housework that I don't have time to go shopping for ingredients.|Kiana|BotW}} Therefore, she asks Link if he could retrieve the ingredients for her.{{Cite|Oh, I know! Could you go and get me the ingredients we're missing?|Kiana|BotW}} If he agrees, Kiana will be happy,{{Cite|[Sure.] Really? I'm happy to hear that. I'll be waiting!|Kiana|BotW}} and the [[Side Quest]] will begin. Goat Butter is sold at [[High Spirits Produce]] in [[Kakariko Village]] and [[The Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]]. In addition, [[Agus]] sells them on his path between [[Dueling Peaks Stable]] and [[Hateno Village]]. Hearty Blueshell Snails, on the other hand, are found on the shores of the [[Lanayru Sea]] and [[Necluda Sea]]. Once Link has acquired both ingredients, he can return to Lurelin Village, where Kiana will ask for them.{{Cite|Oh! You have the ingredients! Can I have them?|Kiana|BotW}} After obtaining them, she will begin to Cook.{{Cite|All right, I'll take those, then. Now to start cooking.|Kiana|BotW}} Before she does, though, she gives Link a [[Purple Rupee]] to thank him.{{Cite|Here's a little something...|Kiana|BotW}} She also invites Link to eat with her family.{{Cite|Since you found the missing ingredients, why don't you eat with us?
It'll be done soon.|Kiana|BotW}} After Cooking, she gives Link some of her Seafood Paella and encourages him to eat it.{{Cite|Go on, dig in! It's deeeee-lish!|Kiana|BotW}}. If Link doesn't have room for the meal, she tells him to make space for it.{{Cite|Aww... Your pouch is full. I can't give you food until you make space for it.|Kiana|BotW}}. If Link makes room for the meal, she celebrates and gives him the meal as usual.{{Cite|You made room in your inventory for my signature dish!|Kiana|BotW}} After obtaining the meal, the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Kiana lives in a family of fishermen in Lurelin Village. She wants to cook her family's favorite meal, seafood paella, but she's too busy with her daily errands and looking after her children to gather all the necessary ingredients.

Be a sport and help her out by gathering the ingredients for her. She needs {{Color BotW|Red|goat butter}} and a {{Color BotW|Red|hearty blueshell snail}} to prepare the dish. |- | Complete | You brought Kiana the goat butter and hearty blueshell snail required for cooking seafood paella. She shared some of the dish with you as thanks!

　　 {{Color BotW|Red|//////Recipe//////}}
1 Goat Butter
1 Hearty Blueshell Snail
1 Mighty Porgy
1 Rock Salt
1 Hylian Rice }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Kiana * Lurelin Village * Side Quest }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
